name: Subtitles
description: Subtitles for movies and episodes from the subtitle sites Bazarr supports, such as OpenSubtitles.com, with their throttling, through the server's proxies, challenge solvers and a captcha solving service; subtitles translated with DeepL, LibreTranslate, Google Translate, Bing, Microsoft Translator or Yandex.Translate.
author: Mavio
